'''Jeffery Nickel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Green Bay tournament (16 September)]] on 16 September 2000 with Corulag Ops, according to Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1236">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-gb-9-16d1236/ gb-9-16], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-gb-9-16d1236/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
